input.content: Pattern: idempotency/recovery record looked up by a natural key (e.g. workspace) instead of the caller-supplied operation ID. Seen in service.py save() (workspace-preferences repo). Effects: (1) a fresh operation ID on the same workspace matches an old completed record and silently no-ops while returning ok (data loss, false success); (2) a retry replays the stored values instead of the latest edited values; (3) new operation IDs are never written to the recovery log, which breaks the audit trail. Contract (README): key by operation_id; retry with edited values must apply the latest values; a fresh ID must do a fresh save. Review check: confirm the dedupe key is the idempotency key, and test "fresh ID, same resource" and "retry with edited values".
